Anya: heads-up — after the int4 bringup for codexica-36k I'm seeing subtle drift in long-context runs. Only reproduces when prefill >20k and when a KV handoff happens mid-token.
Raf: hmm. can you paste repro steps? :eyes:
Anya: repro command below, running on dedicated staging. short sample attached.
Anya: ```bash
./serve_local --model codexica-36k-int4 --context 36000 --prefill-file tests/long_prefill.txt --log-level debug
```
Anya: sample diff: orig: "the committee unanimously agreed" -> quant: "the committe unanimously agreed" (missing character, then later token shift).
Joel: that looks like a small tokenization/alignment drift, but the pattern with handoff makes me think RoPE index rescaling at shard boundary. have you checked rotary phase scale?
Anya: I dumped KV indices. snippet: `KV[shard=2]: last_idx=20481, next_prefill=20482, prefill_len=20483` then on handoff `KV[shard=1]: prefill_len=0` — logs show a 1-token offset during reconcat.
Kai: also note int4 layout compresses some matrix values; rounding could change attention weights slightly and cause different top tokens. but a consistent off-by-one points to indexing, not float noise.
Raf: can you run with `--rotary-scale=1.0000 --dump-kv-fingerprint` and post the fingerprint hashes? if they diverge at the same position we can isolate whether it's RoPE vs cache index.
Anya: running now, attaching quick fingerprint: `fp_before=9af3b2..` `fp_after=9af3b3..` — single-bit change around token 20482.
Joel: single-bit flip where phase multiplier crosses a quant boundary could yield a deterministic off-by-one in the position embedding dot. try `--rotary-scale=0.9999` and `--rotary-scale=1.0001` to see sign/flop.
ci-bot: scheduled perf job codexica-36k-int4-longprefill #472 ran (staging). logs: https://ci.internal/runs/472 :white_check_mark:
Kai: can you also run a control on fp32/float16 so we know if the regression is only in int4 path?
Anya: ran fp16 control — no drift. sequence aligned perfectly. so int4 seems necessary condition.
Raf: ok, plan: (1) bisect quant commit that introduced new packing (2) run rotary-scale sweep (0.9995..1.0005) + kv fingerprint checks (3) add a small guard in cache reattach to verify index continuity and assert if gap>0.
Joel: good. I'll take the bisect unless someone else wants it. Raf, can you add the fingerprint check to the kv-handshake unit test?
Raf: on it. I'll push a tiny test that asserts contiguous indices and stable fingerprint across handoff.
Anya: thanks — I'll drop the failing sample + raw kv dumps into the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-2389. ping me if you want to repro live. :thumbsup:
Kai: For next steps, let's collect a small diff set of 10 failing prompts and run them cross-quant (int4, int8, fp16) and cross-rotary-scale. that'll give us a matrix.
Anya: agree. uploading batch now.
ci-bot: ml/evals job queued: longprefill-handshake-matrix #89. expected ~2h.
Raf: schedule quick sync tomorrow 10am PT to decide cut/fix.
Joel: added to my calendar.
Anya: thanks all, will post updates here as soon as the matrix finishes.
